name: Tan. -Tangent-
source:
Main character descends on a small island. A small girl met on the shore provides a room and becomes his landlord. His life turns into a mess as he gets surrounded by weird female inhabitants. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公来到一座小岛。在岸边遇见的一名娇小少女为他提供了房间，并成了他的房东。随着一群性格古怪的女性居民围到身边，他的生活也变得一团糟。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
